name: @ttypt/sepal
description: Universal Node.js and Browser bindings for libsepal Vector Cosine & Hamming Sketch Engine

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p build/Release && gcc -O3 -fPIC -shared -I/usr/include/node -I../include -I../../libcorm/include -I../../libqsys/include native/sepal_napi.c -L../lib -Wl,-rpath,../lib -L/usr/lib -lsepal -lcorm -lm -o build/Release/sepal_node.node 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:wasm

author: Paulo Quirino
